\[
\text{Area} = \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}
\]

where \(s\) is the semi-perimeter of the triangle:

\[
s = \frac{a + b + c}{2}
\]

\[
\text{Area} = \sqrt{5(5-4)(5-3)(5-3)} = \sqrt{5 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 \cdot 2} = \sqrt{5 \cdot 4} = \sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5}
\]

### Step 2: Factorization in the Algebraic Closure
